messages:
Mira Chen: Quick check on API key UX before handoff. Main asks: make 'Disable' and 'Revoke' distinct, show rotated secret only once, fix modal keyboard/a11y. Figma: [link]. Can we nit copy + accessibility?

Olivia Park: Design preference: default list action = 'Disable key' (safe). Revoke should be two-step (intent -> danger confirm). Use descriptive button labels, avoid 'Yes/No'.

Sam Ortiz: Backend supports both ops. `disable` toggles flag; `revoke` deletes secret + emits audit/org-alert for admin scopes. Rotation returns secret once; include idempotency header.

Lee Nguyen: Frontend: focus trap in modal needs fix. Will add `role=alertdialog`, `aria-describedby`, focus primary on open and return focus to source on close. Ensure toasts use `aria-live=polite`.

Jamal Price: Security: never persist plaintext secret. Rotate panel must require explicit copy/download. Download link should be `rel=noopener` and have an `aria-label`. Warn on wildcard scopes.

a11y-bot: Scan flagged: low contrast on danger text and ambiguous buttons. Recommend `Revoke key` / `Disable key` / `Cancel` labels and accessible color tokens.

Mira Chen: Draft final copy I'll use: 
- Revoke modal body: "Revoking this key prevents any new requests from using it. Existing requests may complete briefly. This action cannot be undone."
- Rotate banner: "This secret will not be shown again. Copy or download now."

Olivia Park: Language looks good. Show irreversible sentence only on final confirm.

Mira Chen: Action items: Olivia update Figma (split revoke flow), Lee modal a11y fixes (PR today), Sam swagger + idempotency (tomorrow AM), Jamal verify audit triggers, a11y-bot re-run checks. I'll paste final acceptance criteria here when ready. Thanks!
